subject: Clarify PO field enforcement and early-pay discount request
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@carepath.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@carepath.com
Date: 2026-06-28T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: PO details for FY27 roll-on + billing cadence

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Procurement asked me to confirm a few specifics so we can route a PO into our ERP:

- Required PO fields: buyer_entity_id, billing_entity_id, cost_center (they all must appear in the PO header or our system rejects it).
- Invoice cadence: default is monthly, but we can accept weekly statements if each invoice contains the PO id and a ledger tag (GL code).
- Net terms: standard is Net45 for our org, but we have a program to take early-pay discounts (1.5% if paid by Net15) that we'd like to apply if acceptable.

Can Redwood accept a PO that includes a separate GL/ledger tag per invoice line? Also, are early-pay discounts compatible with your billing/collections process (i.e., will you issue invoices marked Net15)?

Attaching our PO template for reference.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Carepath Health

[Attachment: Carepath_PO_template.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@carepath.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO details for FY27 roll-on + billing cadence

Hi Elena — thanks for the template and clear list. Quick answers and proposed path:

1) PO header fields: we can require and surface buyer_entity_id, billing_entity_id and cost_center in our billing system. We just need the PO to be issued with those fields in the header (or as a clearly labeled reference) — otherwise our AP matcher will fail.

2) Invoice cadence: monthly by default. We can support weekly invoices for the pilot if the PO includes the GL/ledger tag per invoice line. We'll need a short onboarding ticket to map the GL tags to your ERP codes.

3) Early-pay discount: we can operationalize a 1.5% early-pay if you provide Net15 invoices and a signed amendment that specifies the discount window and the effective invoice types (e.g., usage vs. prebill). Note a few constraints:
   - Discounts are applied to invoices that clear matching checks (PO id + GL tag).
   - We will record the discount as a line-level credit on the invoice; our collections team needs a Net15 flag.

Proposed next steps:
- Vanessa to own the GL mapping and billing lane.
- Kimberly to review the amendment language for the early-pay discount.
- Elena/Procurement to confirm whether the PO will include GL tags line-by-line or as a single header field.

If that works, we can send a short amendment (DocuSign) and a mapping spreadsheet to get you live next week.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@carepath.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@carepath.com
Date: 2026-06-29T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO details for FY27 roll-on + billing cadence

Thanks Sean — that approach should work. A couple of clarifications from procurement:

- We'll include cost_center and billing_entity_id per invoice line (that's our preference). If your system needs a single header field instead, we can do that but prefer line-level mapping.
- Early-pay discount: procurement wants the discount to apply to all usage invoices (not to implementation or one-time setup credits). They'll accept a DocuSign amendment that calls out invoice classes.
- Timing: carepath wants the pilot invoices to be weekly for the first 8 weeks, then revert to monthly.

I'll upload the signed PO to our portal once wording is finalized. Please include the mapping spreadsheet and the sample amendment language so I can route both to our legal team.

Elena

[Procurement note: will need final acceptance in writing before PO goes live.]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO details for FY27 roll-on + billing cadence

Sean / Kim — looping in some operational detail. Echoing Elena: line-level GL tags are preferred by their AP. Our notes:

- We can accept line-level GL tags but need the mapping spreadsheet (sample columns: PO_ID, Invoice_Line_ID, GL_Code, Redwood_Product_Code). I attached a sample mapping template and an SLA exceptions sheet to show where we'd call out weekly vs monthly cadence.
- Collections: marking Net15 will be fine; however, our accounting needs a clear flag on the invoice ("EARLY_PAY_WINDOW:15") so the AR system automatically schedules the discount. Without that flag the invoice will follow standard Net45 collections and discount won't apply.
- Risk/ops guardrails: we require PO header + at least one matching line-level GL tag; otherwise invoices will be put on hold.

I took a pass at amendment language and added it to the SLA-exception spreadsheet. Kim, can you confirm legally this wording is acceptable (I italicized the draft clause for the early-pay discount).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Billing Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SLA-exception-request.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@carepath.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO details for FY27 roll-on + billing cadence

Hi Elena — great, thanks for the quick confirmations. Finalizing details below so procurement/legal can move:

Agreed items:
- Redwood will accept the PO with line-level GL tags. We require the PO header to include buyer_entity_id and billing_entity_id plus at least one line-level GL tag for matching.
- Pilot billing cadence: weekly invoices for first 8 weeks (each invoice must include PO_ID and GL_Code). After the pilot we revert to monthly billing unless you instruct otherwise.
- Early-pay discount: 1.5% if paid within 15 days of invoice date (Net15). Discount applies only to recurring usage invoices; implementation or one-time charges are excluded. Discount will be applied as a credit line on the invoice.
- Preconditions: DocuSign amendment signed and mapping spreadsheet uploaded to our onboarding ticket.

I've attached the amendment (DocuSign link below will go to a short two-paragraph amendment) and the mapping template for your AP team. Once signed, Vanessa will open the ERP mapping ticket and we can schedule the first weekly invoice cycle.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123-carepath-amendment
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/48219

Let me know if you want the amendment to reference a specific Redwood invoice flag name other than "EARLY_PAY_WINDOW:15" — we can accept a naming preference.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
